Tough to make a list like this, limiting it to 10.  I would not have Dreir in the top 10.  He looks really good on paper but I've got him at Mythic D3 with a 4/10 Saber and he still can't keep himself alive too well.  The summon logic is also wonky, preferring attacks vs # of summons for the purpose of determining the hex he lands on.  This can screw you out of 1-2 death riders more often than you might think.

The one you have missing that 100% makes my top 10 is Typhus with relic.  IMO he's a top 5 anytime he matches a scoring track because of the relic.  Once his aura gets to 3 hexes he generates 3 poxes a turn as long as your team can just kill three things.  Would literally not leave home without him.
